title: Active Site Assembly by SMG5 as a Mechanism for SMG6 Endonuclease Licencing in Nonsense-mediated mRNA Decay.
authors: Arpa, Enes S; Taschner, Michael; De Matos, Mara; Jonas, Stefanie; Gatfield, David
one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold结构预测与生化实验，研究SMG5与SMG6 PIN结构域组装复合活性位点以激活核酸内切酶，属于蛋白质-核酸互作机制研究，但对象为mRNA降解体系而非TF-DNA结合，方法以结构预测为主，对TF-DNA互作建模有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: Nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD) is a conserved eukaryotic surveillance pathway that eliminates transcripts containing premature termination codons (PTCs). Substantial progress has been made in defining the transcript features that mark aberrant translation termination for NMD activation, yet key mechanistic steps remain incompletely understood - including how recruitment of the central NMD factor UPF1 is coupled to the downstream effector phase in which targeted mRNAs are nucleolytically degraded. In metazoans, NMD employs an endonucleolytic route mediated by SMG6, a PIN-domain nuclease, alongside SMG5 and SMG7, which act downstream of PTC recognition. SMG5 has recently been proposed to licence SMG6 activity, yet the molecular basis of this licencing has remained elusive. Here, we combine AlphaFold structural predictions with biochemical assays to investigate interactions among human SMG5, SMG6, and SMG7. Structural models predict a high-confidence interface between SMG5 and SMG6 PIN domains that forms a composite active site: a conserved SMG5 aspartate (D893) complements the SMG6 acidic triad to reinstate the canonical tetrad required for PIN-domain catalysis. In vitro, SMG6 alone exhibits weak endonucleolytic activity, which is enhanced  approximately 10-fold by the SMG5 PIN domain. Mutational analyses confirm that conserved residues from both proteins are essential for this composite configuration. Our findings reveal that the SMG5 PIN domain, previously considered catalytically inert, plays a critical role in activating SMG6 by completing its active site. This work provides mechanistic insight into the SMG5-dependent licencing step and uncovers a composite PIN nuclease architecture at the heart of the metazoan NMD effector phase.
abstract_zh: 无义介导的mRNA降解（nonsense-mediated mRNA decay, NMD）是一种保守的真核生物监测通路，用于清除含有提前终止密码子（premature termination codons, PTCs）的转录本。在定义标记异常翻译终止以触发NMD激活的转录本特征方面已取得重大进展，但关键机制步骤仍未被完全理解——包括中央NMD因子UPF1的招募如何与下游效应阶段（靶向mRNA被核酸酶降解）相耦合。在后生动物中，NMD采用由SMG6（一种PIN结构域核酸酶）介导的内切核酸酶途径，同时SMG5和SMG7在PTC识别下游发挥作用。SMG5最近被提出许可SMG6活性，但这一许可的分子基础仍不清楚。在此，我们结合AlphaFold结构预测与生化实验，研究人源SMG5、SMG6和SMG7之间的相互作用。结构模型预测SMG5与SMG6 PIN结构域之间存在高置信度界面，形成复合活性位点：保守的SMG5天冬氨酸（D893）补充SMG6酸性三联体，以恢复PIN结构域催化所需的标准四联体。在体外，SMG6单独表现出弱的内切核酸酶活性，而SMG5 PIN结构域可将其增强约10倍。突变分析证实，两种蛋白中的保守残基对这一复合构型至关重要。我们的发现揭示，先前被认为催化惰性的SMG5 PIN结构域，通过完成SMG6的活性位点，在激活SMG6中发挥关键作用。这项工作为SMG5依赖性许可步骤提供了机制见解，并揭示了后生动物NMD效应阶段核心的复合PIN核酸酶架构。
